summary: Completed comprehensive testing of KR AA Run Health prototype rebuild. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). Frontend navigation, day controls, hero tiles, progress bar, charts, and simulator all functional. Minor UI interaction issues with some action card expansions.
